semantics: Emitter-node transform track (no Spawn/Update of its own; cached by the emitter instance at inst+0x720 by 0x144294000 and evaluated every tick by 0x144294b90 / 0x1442a17a0). All distributions are sampled at emitter time (inst vt+0x2C8(0)). LocalAddPosition / LocalAddScale (helper 0x144277b40): value v = dist(t); if bCurveParameterDirectX the accumulated value = v (curve is the absolute local offset / scale), else accumulated += v * dt (curve is a rate per second; dt = inst+0x668). bInitializeCurveXParameterUseOnly: the distribution is sampled only on the first tick (constant rate / value afterwards). LocalAddRotation: degrees; direct -> absolute Euler angles, else degrees per second integrated and wrapped to [0,360). Velocity: emitter-node velocity (flags as above; consumer not traced). Gravity (0x1442a17a0): g = dist(t) * 60.0 stored at inst+0x464 (a Uniform / UniformCurve distribution is sampled only once, others every tick); each tick v (inst+0x460) += g * axis.z * dt and the accumulated z offset (inst+0x404) += v * dt (dt = inst+0x668); the node matrix is then translated by (inst+0x468 + inst+0x3FC, inst+0x46C + inst+0x400, inst+0x470 + z offset). DisplayType: node billboard mode (0 none, 1 camera, 2..4 axis-locked, 5 screen): consumer not read. bIsUseTransformScale: not read. The node transform composes with the parent node / component according to SQEX_EmitterTakeover.

properties.name: bCurveParameterDirectPosition
properties.meaning: curve = absolute value instead of rate

semantics: Inheritance ("takeover") rules of an emitter node, cached at inst+0x730. Each *TakeoverType is SQEX_TAKEOVER_TYPE: 0 NONE (do not inherit), 1 ALWAYS (follow every tick), 2 SPAWN_TIME_ONLY (copy once when the emitter instance is created). Read in 0x1442a1450 [C]: ParentParticleColorTakeoverType (+0x5A) / ParentParticleAlphaTakeoverType (+0x5B) select the parent colour / alpha source (ALWAYS = live parent data inst+0x530 or inst+0x520, +0x2A0 rgb / +0x2AC a; SPAWN_TIME_ONLY = snapshot inst+0x528); ParticleColorTakeoverType (+0x64) / ParticleAlphaTakeoverType (+0x65) gate the emitter own ColorScaleOverLife-at-emitter-time multiplier. Result = emitter colour multiplier inst+0x480 (rgb) / +0x48C (a). Component* / Parent* Position / Rotation / Scale types do the same for the transform chain (component = the UParticleSystemComponent transform, parent = parent emitter node or parent particle); bLeavePlaceInWorld / bConvertLeavePlaceInWorld: keep already spawned particles in world space; bFadeTakeoverType: inherit the component fade. Functions 0x1442a0ca0, 0x1442a57c0, 0x144280490 read these; not traced line by line. The duplicated *_TakeoverType fields at +108..+116 are a second (older / newer) copy converted in PostLoad 0x1442ed7b0.

Spawn 0x1442f20c0 and Update 0x1442fb700 (every live particle not frozen, Flags & 0x4000000 == 0): bIsAttachPosition and the emitter is not bUseEmitterLocalSpace (Required +0x94 bit1): particle.Location = emitter origin (translation row of the emitter-to-simulation matrix, inst+0x90). bIsAttachRotation: sprite: particle.Rotation = roll of the emitter matrix (deg * pi/180); mesh (inst vt+0x178 gives the mesh rotation payload offset): payload rotation = (payload base rotation) composed with the emitter matrix. Net effect: the particle stays glued to its emitter node (used with SQEX_Parent hierarchies and single-particle emitters).

Spawn-location module (SQEX_LocationBase family; Spawn 0x144373380 -> vt+0x3A8 = 0x144375a40). Local point from vt+0x3A0 (0x144356a00: inside a sphere / disc of RangeRadius, Deviation, DirectionAngle), scaled per axis by RangeScale(emitter time), rotated by Direction, transformed by the emitter (owner scale optional: bApplySpawnLocationOwnerScale). LocationBase adds initial velocity: DirectionType (none / velocity / vertex normal / emitter normal) * Speed.

Per-particle 3-axis rotation in degrees (Spawn 0x1442f2dd0, Update 0x1442fd7b0, core 0x1442ef550; payload: start[3], accumulated[3], rate[3], effective[3], emitter matrix snapshot, own time). Time source: bEmitterTime -> emitter time; bUseParticleModuleTime -> own accumulated time; else particle RelativeTime. scale = ParticleRotationScale(t) (1 when no distribution). Not bParticleRotationSpawnTimeOnly: bCurveParameterDirectRotation ? added = ParticleRotation(t) * scale : accumulated += ParticleRotation(t) * scale * dt, added = accumulated. Spawn-time-only: the value sampled at spawn is reused (rate or direct). Sprite: particle.Rotation = (StartParticleRotation.x + added.x) * pi/180. Mesh: rotation = R(start) * R(added) written to the mesh rotation payload; bMeshRotAdjustEmitterRot / bUseCalcMeshRotMat use the emitter matrix snapshot (not traced).

Makes the emitter a parent node that creates child emitter instances (Update 0x14437a3b0; cached at inst+0x7A8; child instances inst+0x670). For each ChildrenData entry (runtime copy inst+0x688, stride 0x58): template = emitter named GenerateEmitterName (vt+0x340). GenerationConditions TIME: for each TimeDatas {GenerateTime, GenerateNumber}: when emitter time >= GenerateTime (once per loop; LoopNumber limits loops, MaxGenerateCount limits total) create GenerateNumber child emitter instances (vt+0x358), or, when bUseSpawnModule and the LOD level has an SQEX location module, through that module (vt+0x390) so that children appear at spawn-shape positions. PARTICLE_DEATH: children are created when a particle dies (path not traced). LoopEndTime > 0: children of that template get loop-end when emitter time >= LoopEndTime. AllLoopEndTime > 0: all children get loop-end (bGrandsonLoopEnd: recursively). OffsetPosition / Rotation / Scale: child node offset. bToChildren / bChildrenTakeOVerTheParentTime: not traced.

Type data of a non-rendering control emitter: CreateInstance 0x144382fe0 allocates the base Square Enix emitter instance (0x870 bytes, ctor 0x144274de0). Used for pure parent / transform nodes (with SQEX_Parent, SQEX_EmitterTransforms, blur / camera modules).

Cached at inst+0x738. Cuts the emitter node off from the component transform: ComponentRotationTakeoverType / ComponentScaleTakeoverType (NONE / ALWAYS / SPAWN_TIME_ONLY) and bFadeTakeoverType. Readers 0x144284a80, 0x1442a57c0, 0x1442f0040 (ColorScaleOverLife spawn), not traced.

Spawn 0x1442f25f0: payload vec3 = emitter origin - particle.Location (start offset). Cached at inst+0x778.

Spawn-location on a ring: VertexNumber points on radius RangeRadius (RangeRadiusTwo second radius), DirectionAngle, VartexGenerateType (all / in order / random), Interval, RingOffsetPosition / Rotation / Scale; bAttachParticle keeps particles on the ring (Update 0x14437a760). Not traced.

Spawn 0x1442f2650: per-particle float payload = |emitter node scale (inst+0x230)| * DepthOffset. Consumed by the vertex factory as a camera-depth bias in cm (negative = towards the camera); consumer not traced. Cached at inst+0x7B0.

No virtual overrides and no class test found: KillEmitterTime (seconds) is read by emitter-instance code not located. By name: all particles of the emitter are killed when the emitter time reaches KillEmitterTime. Trail asset VW_SO010_LOC0 uses 0.385.
